verdict.rationale: Docs mention automatic scale-to-zero after inactivity with resume from standby in under 25ms 'even after weeks' (blaxel-docs-2), implying state is preserved across pause/resume cycles, and Agent Drive provides a persistent distributed filesystem mountable to sandboxes (blaxel-docs-9). However, there is no explicit developer-triggered pause/resume API, and no confirmation that in-memory process state (not just filesystem) is preserved. missing for 10: explicit manual pause/resume command, explicit statement that memory/process state (not just filesystem) survives resume, independent verification of the claim.
